    Business structure

    Our business areas reflect our focus on packaging based on renewable raw materials, and are described in more detail on this page.

    Foodservice and Liquid Board

    Business Area Foodservice and Liquid Board focuses on developing and innovating packaging materials with a focus on performance, material efficiency, and circular design. It produces Foodservice Boards for items like paper cups, trays, and containers, along with Liquid Packaging Boards for aseptic and fresh products such as milk, juice, yoghurt and soups. The business runs large board production facilities in Finland, Sweden and China, as well as sawmills in several Northern European countries.

    #1 globally in liquid packaging boards
    #1 in Europe in foodservice boards

    Products and applications

    • Liquid packaging board
    • Foodservice board

    Main customer groups

    Packaging converters, food producers, brand owners, retailers

    Cartonboard

    Business Area Cartonboard focuses on developing and innovating packaging materials and book papers with a focus on performance, material efficiency, and circular design. It produces premium fresh fibre packaging boards for food, cosmetics, chocolate, cigarette and pharmaceutical packaging, beverage and multipacks as well as general packaging. The business runs board production facilities in Finland and Sweden.

    #1 in Europe in Fresh cartonboard


    Products and applications

    • Fresh cartonboard
    • Book paper

    Main customer groups

    Packaging converters, food producers, brand owners, retailers, book producers

    Containerboard

    Business Area Containerboard is dedicated to developing and innovating packaging materials with a focus on performance, material efficiency, and circular design. It serves a wide range of packaging and paper needs in food, e-commerce, consumer, electronics, and industrial applications.

    With production in Finland, (including sawmilling & LVL), Poland and Belgium and a recycling depot network in Poland, Containerboard is a global leader in virgin-fiber containerboard, complemented by a highly competitive recycled offering.

    Products and applications

    • Brown and white-top kraftliners
    • Testliners
    • Fluting
    • Bag paper
    • MG Kraft
    • UKP (unbleached market pulp)
    • Newsprint and magazine paper

    Main customer groups

    Packaging manufacturers, brand owners and retailers in the fresh produce, food and beverage, industrial applications, e-commerce, electronics and transport industries.

    Packaging Solutions

    Packaging Solutions focuses on paper-based packaging designed to meet performance and material-efficiency requirements. We deliver premium packaging to leading brands in retail, e-commerce, and industrial markets, while providing design and automation services that improve material use, and streamline logistics.

    Products and applications

    • Corrugated cardboard boxes and trays
    • Rigid boxes
    • Packaging design and automation
    • Converting of carton and corrugated board

    Main customer groups

    Brand owners in fresh produce, horticulture, food and beverage, industrial applications, e-commerce, electronics, retail and transport industries

    Biomaterials

    The Biomaterials Business Area serves demanding customers with specialised pulp across packaging, hygiene, medical care and industrial applications. Through innovation, Biomaterials uses all fractions of the tree and enables long-term value creation by growing business in new high-performance renewable materials.

    #1     fluff producer in Europe
    #1  Specialised UKP1

    1) UKP market pulp by Stora Enso
     

    Products and applications

    • Pulp
    • Hard carbon battery material
    • Lignin
    • Biobased binders
    • Wood foams
    • Biobased chemicals
    • Tall oil and turpentine

    Main customer groups

    Packaging, paper, tissue, specialty paper, hygiene products, construction, and furniture industries and chemical producers

    Wood and Energy

    Business Area Wood and Energy encompasses Business units Wood Products, Wood Supply, and Energy, as well as Stora Enso’s shares of forest assets in associated companies.

    Each business unit is described in more detail below.


    Business unit Wood Products is Europe’s largest sawn timber producer and a leading provider of wood-based products made from renewable raw materials for building applications. These products are designed to meet performance requirements while supporting resource-efficient construction. The customer portfolio includes structural and decorative wood products, windows and door components, planed and painted profiles, as well as high value co products such as pellets made from wood residuals.

    Business unit Wood Supply provides efficient and sustainable wood supply to all Stora Enso Nordic production units and our B2B partners. Wood Supply work is rooted in sustainable forest management, covering forest planning, harvesting, logistics, terminal operations and silviculture. The business unit creates value for private forest owners through sustainable forest management and high-quality customer service. Wood Supply is committed to supporting biodiversity through forest management practices and collaboration with forest owners and partners.

    Business unit Energy supports efficient energy operations across Stora Enso. The business unit supports Stora Enso production units by optimizing power assets, managing trading, and providing expert services. The business unit role is to strengthen operational efficiency, ensure regulatory compliance, and facilitate knowledge sharing in all energy related matters throughout Stora Enso.

    Privacy Preference Center

    When you visit any Stora Enso website, we store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information can be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Depending on your choice, we can also share information about your use of our site with our analytics and marketing partners. Since we respect your right to privacy you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.

    Manage Consent Preferences

    Strictly Necessary Cookies

    Always Active

    These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

    Preference Cookies

    These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

    Statistical Cookies

    These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.

    Marketing Cookies

    These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
